item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files cross-region data copy and synchronization with Azure Storage Mover
item.description:
Azure Files now supports copying and synchronizing file share data across storage accounts, Azure regions, and subscriptions within the same tenant using Azure Storage Mover. The feature is in public preview and supports scheduled incremental transfers to maintain secondary copies.

  • Source: Azure Updates
